title: 3-Year Treasury Note auction (December new issue) — on Monday, with the block stepping around the 12-09 FOMC decision
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF (home.treasury.gov/system/files/221/Tentative-Auction-Schedule.pdf), fetched direct by plain curl 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes), text layer decompressed and rebuilt PAGE BY PAGE from Tm coordinates. The page-3 row reads verbatim `3-Year NOTE / Thursday, December 03, 2026 / Monday, December 07, 2026 / Tuesday, December 15, 2026`, with no `R` and no `T` marker — a NEW ISSUE, matching `reopening: "No"` on all 200 3-Year rows in fiscaldata `auctions_query` back to 2010-02-09. 1:00pm ET is Treasury's standing coupon-auction convention and is NOT separately sourced. Filed estimate: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep — the confirming primary is the 2026-12-03 coupon announcement. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: DISCOVERED during the treasury-3y-note-2026-11-09 never-assessed initial research (2026-09-09), reading the same schedule PDF that dates that event. Filed because it is the direct successor in this lane's own series and NOTHING tracks it: the calendar carries treasury-3y-note-2026-09-08, -10-06 and -11-09 as first-class medium-impact entries, there is no canonical or proposed December 3-Year anywhere, and unlike the November leg (which the refunding statement owns) December has no coupon-announcement entry either, so no sibling sweep is positioned to find it. ONE auction is filed, not the block. STRUCTURAL NOTE, and the reason this row is worth a ledger rather than a line: the December block runs 3-Year Monday 12-07, 10-Year Tuesday 12-08, 30-Year Thursday 12-10 — with nothing on Wednesday 12-09, which is the FOMC decision day (`fomc-2026-12-09`, already tracked). The block steps around the meeting the way the November block steps around the Veterans Day closure, so the 3-Year again prices BEFORE the corridor's dominant macro event rather than after it. December CPI lands 12-10 and the continuing-resolution expiry 12-11, both after the auction. EXPECTED SIZE, per the grid rather than any current document: $58B, which would be the 24th consecutive $58B new issue since 2024-04-09; the number becomes published on 2026-12-03, and the size decision itself belongs to the 2026-11-04 quarterly refunding statement. DISCOVERED IN THE SAME SWEEP AND DELIBERATELY NOT FILED, named here so a sibling can: the December 10-Year reopening (announce 12-03, auction 12-08, settle 12-15, carries `R`), the December 30-Year reopening (announce 12-03, auction 12-10, settle 12-15, carries `R`), and the January 3-Year new issue (announce 2027-01-07, auction 2027-01-11, settle 2027-01-15). Proposed as an estimate; symbols: [] and no house playbook is rates-keyed, so nothing here licenses an entry.
